sources.title: Qwen-Image NSFW LoRA Notes | Civitai
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image ( 20B parameters) struggles with NSFW generation - Flux.1 has 12B parameters. LoRA fine-tuning ( 10-20M trainable parameters, rank 128) improves anatomy generation. A small dataset of 100-300 images won't do it. A general-purpose NSFW LoRA requires a minimum of 1,500+ handpicked, high-quality images, carefully captioned, and trained with a minimum rank of 128.
